contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report): 17,888.86', which equals the cover's 'This Report' line-1 cell (17,888.86)
contributions.detail: 13 handwritten Form A rows: 3,589.90 + 500.00 + 100.00 + 200.00 + 10.00 + 250.00 + 250.00 + 5,000.00 + 288.96 + 3,900.00 + 100.00 + 200.00 + 3,500.00 = 17,888.86 — EXACTLY the schedule's own printed total and the cover's This-Report cell. Cumulative is 21,188.86 over a Last-Report 3,300.00 (3,300.00 + 17,888.86 = 21,188.86), so the schedule is period-scoped behind a cumulative cover and the prior 3,300.00 is not itemized here. Row-count gate: 13 filled bands of 23 measured. The close is what settles row 1, whose leading digit is written over a heavier struck glyph: only 3,589.90 makes the schedule sum to its own total. 2026 is a 3-line form with a single 'Total Contributions' cell and no separate <=$50 aggregate line, so the whole published This-Report contributions figure is anchored here — note the filer itemized a $10.00 gift he was not required to itemize.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report)' — the cover's This-Report line-2 cell is 16,577.69 and the cover closes four ways on that figure (954.67 + 16,577.69 = 17,532.36 cumulative; 17,888.86 - 16,577.69 = 1,311.17 This-Report balance; 2,345.33 + 1,311.17 = 3,656.50 cumulative balance), so 16,577.69 is the anchor even though the schedule's own handwritten total reads as 16,577.09 at 1200 dpi
expenditures.detail: ⚠ THIS SIDE DOES NOT CLOSE AND THE DIFFERENCE COULD NOT BE TRACED — the one unreconciled side in this chunk, flagged for a second reader. The 24 handwritten Form B rows, each read at 900-1200 dpi, sum to 16,628.86 against an anchor of 16,577.69: a residual of 51.17 (50.57 against the 16,577.09 the schedule itself appears to print). Two independent facts are recorded rather than resolved. FIRST, the filer's own two figures for the same quantity disagree: the cover says 16,577.69 and the schedule total reads 16,577.09, a 0.60 gap that exists before any transcription question. SECOND, no single row explains the ~51: every amount cell was re-rendered as a tight crop and re-read, and the only two that remain bistable are row 2 (2.50 vs 2.00, +/-0.50) and row 11 (117.95 vs 117.75/117.85, +/-0.20) — even at the extremes of that ambiguity the residual stays between 50.47 and 51.17, and no candidate row equals ~51. Nothing was nudged: the rows are recorded as read and the anchor is recorded as printed. What the row set IS good for: it is a complete, geometry-proved list of the 24 entries the filer itemized, and its dollar figure is within 0.31% of his own total. It must NOT be used as the filing's expenditure total — for that, `filing_totals.csv`'s stated 16,577.69 governs, per the module's rule that the vision-transcribed stated totals are ground truth and are never recomputed.

itemized.escalation_note: 21 escalation crops, far more than any other filing in this chunk, because this is the only fully HANDWRITTEN filing here and the only side that would not close. Geometry first: 900 dpi crops of the head of each schedule established that Form A prints a wide column-header band AND a blank spacer band before row 1 while Form B's header band absorbs the spacer and row 1 starts immediately — a one-band difference between two sheets of the SAME filing, which would have shifted every row index on one of them. Then the arithmetic hunt on Form B: the amount column was re-rendered as six 13%-wide slices at 900 dpi (near-native resolution, ~5x the effective dpi of a full page) and every one of the 24 cells re-read; four individual cells (rows 2, 11, 12 and the printed total) were then escalated again to 1200 dpi. That escalation CHANGED two readings from the full-page pass (row 2 from 2.00 to 2.50, row 11 from 117.75 to 117.95) and confirmed the other 22, but it did not close the side — which is the Rhodes ruling working as intended: resolution settles legibility, not truth, and the arithmetic verdict stands as `delta`. Finally the DATE columns of both schedules were re-rendered as strips, which recovered the two date facts below (the obliterated Form A day and the 6/9/26 Form B row).

itemized.notes: Duane D. Kearsley, 'Weber Co. Commissioner Seat A' (the office line as written on the form; index.csv carries the abbreviated 'Weber Co. Commission Seat A'), 2026 cycle, the 'May 26 - Pre-Primary Election' box ticked, signed 5/26/2026 — a date index.csv leaves blank but which is plainly legible on the form. Page order is form order: cover p1, Form A p2, Form B p3. ⚠ THIS IS THE ONLY FULLY HANDWRITTEN FILING IN THE CHUNK and the only one with an unreconciled side; it is also on the NEW 2026 form, whose schedules differ structurally from every earlier year here: Form A has no separate Address column (an unlabelled band carries the city/state, with the street omitted entirely by the filer) and Form B has NO City and NO Purpose column at all, so payee and purpose share one cell and no vendor city exists to record. Both schedules are rotated landscape sheets (Amount along the top of the rendered page, rows advancing left-to-right), and the two sheets of this one filing have DIFFERENT header-band structures — Form A prints a header band plus a blank spacer before row 1, Form B's header band absorbs the spacer — which is a one-band indexing trap that was crop-proved on each sheet rather than assumed. THE CONTRIBUTIONS SIDE CLOSES EXACTLY (17,888.86, period-scoped over a 3,300.00 carry-forward) and is safe to use. THE EXPENDITURE SIDE DOES NOT: 24 geometry-proved rows sum to 16,628.86 against the filer's own 16,577.69, a 51.17 residual that survived re-reading every cell at 900-1200 dpi and could not be traced to any row — recorded as a `delta`, with the rows kept exactly as read and the published stated total left governing. Two further honest defects in the source, both preserved: Form A row 5's DAY is scribbled out beyond recovery (no date recorded — the month and year alone are not a date) and that row is also the only one with no city or state written; and Form B row 19 is dated 6/9/26, two weeks AFTER the report was signed. Neither schedule is in date order. The candidate's street address and city/zip are BLACKED OUT on the cover by the county before publication (the government's own redaction, preserved and not recovered, PRIVACY.md); the two handwritten phone numbers print in the clear and are deliberately not carried.
